**Project context:**
This is a research simulation engine modeling pathways from AI super-alignment to sustainable human flourishing. It uses a phase-based architecture with 37 simulation phases, tracks multi-dimensional systems (AI capabilities, quality of life, environmental debt), and enforces research-backed mechanics.

**What I can help with:**
